action: Chop bruma roots, feed and repair braziers, reach at least 500 personal points, then repeat until you gain {xp} Firemaking XP for level {target}. Fletch only when needed to secure the 500-point threshold.
supplies: Equip four warm items and bring a knife, hammer, and cakes. Each cake bite heals at least 4 Hitpoints and restores 35% warmth under the current warmth system. {observed}
location: Wintertodt camp in northern Great Kourend.
note: Round length, interruptions, fletching, and player levels change XP per game. Exact XP remaining is shown without inventing a fixed kill count.

action: Load the vessel with raw karambwanji, fish the static spot until full, take fairy ring DKP to Zanaris, bank, return through the Zanaris ring to DKP, and repeat until you gain {xp} Fishing XP for level {target}.
supplies: Bring a karambwan vessel, raw karambwanji, and a dramen or lunar staff unless staffless fairy-ring use is unlocked. {observed}
location: Karambwan fishing spot north of fairy ring DKP on north-east Karamja.
note: The static spot and stackable bait make this the low-attention option. Faster bank teleports can improve the loop later without being assumed here.

action: Fill every usable essence pouch, follow the safe altar path, craft the mixed rune result, bank, and repeat until you gain {xp} Runecraft XP for level {target}.
supplies: Bring pure essence and every usable essence pouch; leave inventory space for the mixed runes. {observed}
location: Ourania Altar, southwest of Ardougne.
note: Ourania produces a mix of runes, and XP per essence depends on the result distribution and account level. Treat the remaining essence count as variable.

action: Mine pay-dirt on the lower level, clean it through the hopper, empty the sack, bank the ores, and repeat until you gain {xp} Mining XP for level {target}. Keep golden nuggets for planned unlocks.
supplies: Bring {pickaxe}. {observed}
location: Motherlode Mine beneath Falador.
note: Vein uptime and pay-dirt flow vary. Golden-nugget goals such as Prospector or upper-level access can remain protected beyond an arbitrary level milestone.

action: Perform the already verified team role and complete Volcanic Mine rounds until you gain {xp} Mining XP for level {target}.
supplies: Bring {pickaxe} plus the food and stamina supplies in the verified team-role setup.
location: Volcanic Mine on Fossil Island.
note: Vent state, role, boulder phase, and points change XP per game, so no fixed game count is shown.

action: Place dynamite, light it, move clear, excavate the blasted rock, collect the ore, and repeat until you gain {xp} Mining XP for level {target}.
supplies: Bring dynamite and {pickaxe}. {observed}
location: Blast Mine in Lovakengj.
note: Ore tier and timing affect XP and dynamite use, so the plugin keeps the exact XP gap without claiming a universal dynamite count.

action: Complete all three displayed potion orders together for the 40% resin bonus, then take the next three. Repeat until you gain {xp} Herblore XP toward level {target}.
supplies: Bring herbs already committed to Mixology and convert them into the displayed Mox, Aga, and Lye paste shortfalls. {observed}
location: Alchemical Society in Aldarin.
note: Order combinations change continuously. Exact paste-to-level counts require live order state; XP per order is not assumed constant.

action: Rake one allotment, plant three potato seeds, leave while they grow, then return with a spade to harvest and replant; repeat this loop until you gain {xp} Farming XP toward level {target}.
supplies: Bring three potato seeds, a rake, seed dibber, and spade. Buy tools from Sarah at the farm and potato seeds from Olivia in Draynor Village when missing. {observed}
location: South Falador Farm allotments, between Falador and Port Sarim.
note: Harvest yield and disease are variable, so Compass does not invent a seed-to-level count. Compost is optional but reduces disease and improves yield.

action: Rake one allotment, plant three watermelon seeds, leave while they grow, then return with a spade to harvest and replant. Repeat until you gain {xp} Farming XP toward level {target}.
supplies: Bring three watermelon seeds, a rake, seed dibber, and spade. If seeds are missing, pickpocket Master Farmers in Draynor Village until you have three; the number of pickpockets is variable. {observed}
location: South Falador Farm allotments, between Falador and Port Sarim.
note: Harvest yield and disease are variable, so Compass does not invent a seed-to-level count. Compost is optional but reduces disease and improves yield.

action: Track and harvest herbiboars until you gain {xp} Hunter XP toward level {target}. Bank or process herbs according to the account's Herblore needs.
supplies: Bring a herb sack when owned, plus stamina or graceful-style movement support if useful. {observed}
location: Herbiboar hunting area on Fossil Island.
note: Track length and herb rewards vary. Iron accounts may prefer this over higher raw Hunter XP when Herblore supplies are scarce.

action: Run Pyramid Plunder and spend most of the timer in the highest rooms you can access until you gain {xp} Thieving XP toward level {target}.
supplies: Bring food or healing, antipoison if your route needs it, and free inventory space for loot. {observed}
location: Pyramid Plunder in Sophanem.
note: Room access, failed traps, chest and sarcophagus choices, and sceptre hunting change XP per run, so no fixed run count is shown.

action: Pickpocket wealthy citizens when a street urchin distracts them until you obtain a house key. Unlock an empty house, search the wardrobes, chests, and jewellery cases, take each flashing-object bonus, escape through the window, and repeat until you gain {xp} Thieving XP toward level {target}.
supplies: Bring a chisel for blessed bone statuettes and leave inventory space for valuables. {observed}
location: Wealthy citizens in the Civitas illa Fortis bazaar, then Caius', Victor's, or Lavinia's empty house in the south-west city.
note: House availability and loop timing vary, so exact XP remaining is shown without claiming a fixed number of robberies.

action: Fish harpoonfish, cook the catch, load both cannons, tether during waves, and repeat until you gain {xp} Fishing XP for level {target}.
supplies: {temporossSupplies}
location: Tempoross island, entered from the Ruins of Unkah ferry.
note: Cooking choice, team size, storm timing, and reward strategy change Fishing XP per game, so no fake game count is shown.

action: Mine fragments, craft guardian essence, enter the open altars, charge guardians, and place cells until you gain {xp} Runecraft XP for level {target}.
supplies: Bring a pickaxe and chisel.{pouches}
location: Guardians of the Rift arena in the Temple of the Eye.
note: Portal timing, altar choices, pouch capacity, and match outcome change XP per game. The planner therefore reports the exact XP gap, not a fabricated match count.

action: {starScout} Mine the located star until it depletes or you gain {xp} Mining XP toward level {target}.
supplies: Bring {pickaxe}. Keep stardust when Celestial ring or charge rewards still matter. {observed}
location: {starLocation}
note: Stars land at random from fixed sites, so Compass cannot truthfully name an active crash site without observing one. Star tier changes while mining and affects XP; exact swing counts would be false precision.

action: Ask Kovac for a commission. Load {alloy} into the crucible. For each blade section, select the owned mould with the highest green score shown for that commission, pour the sword, then work every temperature station inside its target band. Repeat for {xp} Smithing XP toward level {target}.
supplies: Bring {alloy}; each commissioned sword consumes 28 bars' worth of metal. {observed}
location: Giants' Foundry beneath Kovac's workshop, east of Al Kharid.
note: The 14/14 adjacent-metal alloy is a verified default when both metals are observed. Mould score, commission, and mistakes change XP per sword, so no fixed sword count is shown.

action: Ask Amy for a {contract} contract, travel to the named client, repair every marked hotspot, speak to the client, and take another {contract} contract. Repeat for {xp} Construction XP toward level {target}.
supplies: Bring a hammer, saw, at least 15 {plankLower}, one steel bar, and teleports for Falador, Varrock, East Ardougne, and Hosidius. Use a plank sack when owned. {observed}
location: Amy at Mahogany Homes, immediately south of Falador Park.
note: Furniture mix varies by client, so exact planks and XP per contract require the live contract state. No universal contract count is fabricated.

action: Take {seed} seeds from the table. Plant and immediately water a 20-plot cycle, revisit each plant for every watering stage, harvest, deposit the fruit, and repeat for {xp} Farming XP to level {target}.
supplies: Bring a spade, seed dibber, and eight filled watering cans; Gricoller's can replaces the eight cans. {observed}
location: Tithe Farm in Hosidius.
note: Plot count and missed cycles change XP per hour. Reward goals such as the can, seed box, or outfit can remain protected instead of being abandoned at a level breakpoint.

action: At {patch}, harvest each ready allotment, plant three {seedLower} in each cleared allotment, compost, and return after the crop is ready. Repeat for {xp} Farming XP to level {target}.
supplies: Bring six {seedLower}, a rake, seed dibber, spade, and compost. {observed}
location: {patch}.
note: Harvest yield is variable, so a seed-to-level count would be false. Patch state, seed supply, and travel access should drive the next run.

action: At {patch}, harvest any ready herbs, plant {herbSeed}, apply compost when carried, and return after the patch is ready. Repeat for {xp} Farming XP to level {target}.
supplies: Bring {herbSeed}, a seed dibber, and a spade. Compost is optional but protects yield. {observed}
location: {patch}.
note: Herb yield is variable and Iron accounts may value potion supply over raw Farming XP, so no fabricated exact seed count is shown.

action: Ask Guildmaster Jane for a {contract} contract. Grow the named crop inside the Farming Guild, check its health or finish harvesting it, claim the seed pack, and request another {contract} contract. Farming still needs {xp} XP to level {target}.
supplies: Keep common contract seeds and planting tools available when storage allows. {observed}
location: Guildmaster Jane in the central Farming Guild greenhouse, Kebos Lowlands.
note: Contracts are primarily a seed-supply progression loop, not constant XP per contract. They should be surfaced as a detour when the seed value outweighs continuous training.

action: Get a {rumourTier} rumour from {hunter}. Hunt the named creature until it drops the rare part, return the part for the loot sack, and take another rumour. Repeat for {xp} Hunter XP toward level {target}.
supplies: Bring the trap or tool required by the assigned creature and your hunter's whistle when available. {observed}
location: {hunter} in the Burrow beneath the Hunter Guild, Varlamore.
note: Assignment and rare-part RNG change XP per rumour. Creature-specific loadouts should replace this generic setup once the current rumour can be observed directly.

action: On an official Forestry world, cut {tree} and complete each event that spawns until you gain {xp} Woodcutting XP toward level {target}.
supplies: Bring {axe} and a Forestry kit when owned. {observed}
location: {treeLocation}
note: Event frequency and event type vary, so exact event counts are not meaningful. The planner treats Forestry as varied Woodcutting plus reward progression.
